# HeyDots - AI Automation Agency

HeyDots is an AI consulting and automation agency that builds intelligent AI ecosystems, custom autonomous agents, and automated workflows for modern businesses.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: HeyDots
- **Website**: https://heydots.com
- **Email**: info@heydots.com
- **Type**: AI Automation Agency / AI Consulting Firm
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Headquarters**: Global Remote-First

## Core Services
1. **AI Chatbots & Voice Solutions** - 24/7 AI-powered customer support and voice assistants
2. **Automated Lead Generation Pipelines** - AI-driven systems to capture and qualify leads automatically
3. **Generative Content Systems** - AI content creation for marketing, blogs, and internal documentation
4. **Custom AI Agents** - Tailored autonomous agents for specific business workflows
5. **Workflow & Data Pipeline Automation** - End-to-end automation of business processes and data flows
6. **AI Strategy & Consulting** - Strategic guidance for AI implementation and digital transformation

## Target Audience
- Small to medium-sized businesses
- Startups and scale-ups
- Enterprises seeking AI transformation
- Companies with repetitive manual processes
- Businesses looking to scale operations efficiently

## Key Differentiators
- **Human-Guided AI Workflows**: We build observable, human-guided AI systems that maintain control while automating
- **End-to-End Solutions**: From strategy to implementation and ongoing optimization
- **Custom-Built Agents**: Not just off-the-shelf tools, but tailored solutions for specific business needs
- **Measurable ROI**: Focus on tangible business outcomes and performance metrics
- **Global Remote-First Team**: Expert engineers and AI specialists available worldwide

## Technology Stack
- Large Language Models (GPT, Claude, custom fine-tuned models)

- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure)
- CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive)
